_register: Formal polite style (합쇼체): statements end in -ㅂ니다/-습니다 and requests in -하십시오 (e.g. 바코드를 스캔하십시오), never the casual 해체 or the chatty 해요체 with exclamations; buttons, menu entries and headings are bare nouns or verb stems (대출, 저장, 반납 처리, 삭제) with no sentence ending; no jokes, no exclamation marks; no honorific address to the reader (no 고객님, 사용자님).
_quotes: Double curved quotes “ text ” with no inner spaces (e.g. 대출됨: “{{title}}”); nested quotes use ‘ ’; the arrow → stays. Words are separated by spaces (띄어쓰기) but particles and endings attach directly to the noun with no space; because the particle depends on whether the last syllable has a final consonant (은/는, 이/가, 을/를, 으로/로), never put a particle right after a {{placeholder}} — rephrase so that the placeholder stands before a colon, a dash or a noun (e.g. “대상: {{name}}”, “{{name}} 학생”, “{{title}} 도서”). Units attach to numbers without a space (3권, 5명) or with one when the number is a placeholder followed by a counter in the sentence; keep one style. Full-width punctuation is not used: write the ASCII . , : ? with a normal space after.
_plural: Korean has no grammatical plural: only the form `other` is written in every {{count:plural; …}} message, and the counted noun takes its counter after the number (명 for people, 권 for books and copies, 건 for items, records and loans, 개 for generic things, 학급 or 반 for classes), e.g. {{count}}명, {{count}}권.

copy.note: One physical copy of a title with its own barcode (등록번호 in KORMARC and in Korean school-library systems such as DLS, which treat each copy as a 자료 with a 등록번호). « 복본 » means a duplicate of a title already held, so it is not used; the barcode of a copy is « 등록번호 » only in help texts, « 바코드 » in labels.

record.note: The catalogue entry of a title (KORMARC 서지 레코드); « 도서 정보 » is the plain alternative but « 서지 정보 » matches DLS and Koha Korean. A record has one or more 소장본.

patron.note: A student or teacher who borrows; the standard word in Korean library law and software (« 회원 » is used by public-library web services, « 대출자 » only for the person who holds a loan).

card.note: The library card with a barcode; school libraries also say « 학생증 » when the student ID doubles as the card, but the program's card is its own, so « 도서관 이용증 » in full where the context is not clear.

return.note: The action; verb « 반납하다 ». Not « 반환 ».

renew.note: Extending the due date; short form « 연장 » on a button. Not « 갱신 » (used for card renewal).

due date.note: Short form « 반납일 » only in table headers.

overdue.note: As an adjective « 연체된 », e.g. « 연체된 도서 »; also « 연체 중 ».

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; « 반납 독촉장 » in full. Not « 연체료 » (fines do not exist in the program).

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS), as in KORMARC and all Korean libraries; not « 별치기호 », which is only the location prefix.

spine band.note: The coloured band on the spine with pictogram and 청구기호; short « 책등 라벨 ».

label.note: An adhesive label with a barcode: « 바코드 라벨»; the generic word is « 라벨 » (not « 레이블 »).

class.note: A school class such as 3 B; the number is written 3학년 2반 in Korean schools, but the program shows the label as configured, so the generic word is « 학급 ».

group.note: Used for a group of teachers (« 교사 그룹 »).

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for; « 권장 학년 » would be a longer paraphrase and is not used.

classification.note: The sorting scheme; Korean libraries use KDC (한국십진분류법) for non-fiction, « 분류법 » for the scheme itself.

catalogue.note: The whole catalogue of the library; « 목록 » alone only in a menu where the context is clear. Not « 카탈로그 ».

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue, the standard term in Korean school libraries (« 장서점검 »); written with a space for readability; « 재물조사 » is not used.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « 희망도서 신청 » is the established practice in Korean school and public libraries.

census.note: Registering patrons with their photo; the program calls the whole activity « 사진 등록 » (« 사진 일괄 등록 » for the batch task).

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; the Korean school year starts in March, so the text avoids « September ».

staff account.note: A shared login per role; « 사서 계정 » is not used because not every operator is a librarian (사서).

backup.note: The loanword is the usual software word; « 예비 복사본 » is not used.

colour set.note: The palette of the interface; « 색상 세트 » is also understood.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « 바코드 리더 » is also used in libraries, but « 스캐너 » is the word of the verb « 스캔하다 ».

wizard.note: The first-start sequence of questions; « 마법사 » is the Korean software word.

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with; « 샘플 데이터 » is also used by Korean software.

teacher.note: Not « 선생님 » (too familiar for UI text).

school year.note: The year of a school's calendar (2026학년도); « 학년 » alone is the grade level (1학년, 2학년).

administration.note: Menu name; « 관리자 » is the person. In full: « 관리 설정 ».

template.note: Print template: « 인쇄 서식 »; « 템플릿 » is understood but the Korean word is plainer.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; « 대출반납대 » is the school-library word, but « 데스크 » is shorter for a menu; the area as a whole is « 대출 ».
